node.statement: By the preceding computation, the first three rows have the required forms. Independently, row_4(A_lambda)=(lambda,1-lambda), so the definition of matrix multiplication gives row_4(A_lambda M_lambda)=lambda u+(1-lambda)v=(lambda(1-lambda),(1-lambda)^2,lambda^2,lambda(1-lambda)). These four calculations cover every row because A_lambda has exactly four rows; hence, with P_lambda:=A_lambda M_lambda, they establish the complete four-row list asserted in node 1.9.4 (and thus its contribution to 1.9).
